page_title: BET 1-3 ALA | Betis v Alaves 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johnny Cardoso (Betis) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Vitor Roque (Betis) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+2' The referee shows a yellow card to Isco (Betis). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Vitor Roque (Betis) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Garcia leaves the pitch and Santiago Mourino (Alaves) comes on.

84' 1 - 3 Goal! Carlos Vicente plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Kike Garcia (Alaves), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:3.
82' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Moussa Diarra (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
80' 1 - 2 Goal! Kike Garcia (Alaves) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
79' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
78' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
77' The game has come to an end for Jon Guridi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
77' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Stoichkov (Alaves) replaces Tomas Conechny.
76' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Tomas Conechny (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
73' Isco (Betis) dribbles into the box, but Jesus Owono is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
71' It is time for a substitution. Mateo Flores (Betis) is on for Pablo Fornals.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marc Roca (Betis) replacing Jesus Rodriguez.
69' 51:49 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
66' Jesus Rodriguez latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Isco (Betis) and heads towards goal.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is replacing Antonio Blanco.
63' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
60' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Abde Ezzalzouli and he is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
60' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
55' Romain Perraud (Betis) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
54' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
53' A spell of possession for Betis in an attempt to control the game.
51' Kike Garcia (Alaves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' The attendance for today's match is 50021.
48' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Tomas Conechny (Alaves), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the right of the goal.
48' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Natan (Betis) replaces Youssouf Sabaly.
46' The whistle blows and Alejandro Hernandez starts the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+4' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
45+2' Isco (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45+1' Isco (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Jesus Owono comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

44' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
41' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Romain Perraud.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Llorente (Betis) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
34' This is a yellow card! Vitor Roque (Betis) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

28' 1 - 1 Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) scores a goal after an exquisite individual effort! He skips past a few defenders and pulls the trigger from just outside the box. He sends the ball towards the bottom right corner and it glances in off the post.
28' Isco (Betis) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
28' Isco (Betis) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
28' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Adrian is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
26' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
25' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Alaves! Play can continue.

23' Play continues despite the shouts by some Alaves players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
18' The foul by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
14' Some great controlled play and passing from Betis. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Adrian gets a hand on the penalty from Kike Garcia (Alaves), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
11' Kike Garcia (Alaves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
9' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Marc Bartra (Betis) commits a foul after dangerous play. That is a penalty kick for Alaves.
8' Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Adrian blocks the shot with his legs.
5' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) plays a one-two with Isco, but the move breaks down.
4' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
2' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Vitor Roque (Betis) inside the box.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez was nominated as the referee for this game.
